  #define __ifaddrs_h

#ifndef __QBFC_EXTERN

        #define QBFC_EXTERN extern
    #else

/*********************************************************************/
/* Header files                                                      */
/*********************************************************************/

#include <sys/socket.h>               /* sockaddr structure          */
#include <sys/types.h>                /* common typedefs             */
#if (__OS400_TGTVRM__>=510)
#pragma datamodel(P128)
#endif

/*********************************************************************/
/* Structures                                                        */
/*********************************************************************/

struct ifaddrs
{
  struct ifaddrs  *ifa_next;          /* pointer to next structure   */
  char            *ifa_name;          /* interface name              */
  uint32_t         ifa_flags;         /* interface flags             */
  struct sockaddr *ifa_addr;          /* interface address           */
  struct sockaddr *ifa_netmask;       /* interface netmask           */
  union
  {
    struct sockaddr *ifu_broadaddr;   /* broadcast address           */
    struct sockaddr *ifu_dstaddr;     /* P2P interface destination   */
  }                ifa_ifu;
  void            *ifa_data;          /* address specific data       */
};

/*********************************************************************/
/* Function prototypes                                               */
/*********************************************************************/
#if (__OS400_TGTVRM__ < 510) || \
  ((__OS400_TGTVRM__ >= 510) && !defined(__LLP64_IFC__))

  /* Start changes for _XOPEN_SOURCE */

  #endif

#else
  QBFC_EXTERN int getifaddrs(struct ifaddrs * __ptr64 * __ptr64);
  /* Start changes for _XOPEN_SOURCE */
  #if ((_XOPEN_SOURCE+1>520) && !defined(COMPAT_43))
  /* _XOPEN_SOURCE is defined to be >= 520 & not BSD 4.3 compatibility */

#endif /* ... __LLP64_IFC__ */

QBFC_EXTERN void freeifaddrs(struct ifaddrs *);
